answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the ferrous queue while honest participants promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 616 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the anchor. The onyx index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 145 pays that 300 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
